tei:div.tei:p: With eternal love dost Thou love Thy people, the House of Israel. Torah, commandments, statutes and judgments hast Thou taught us. Therefore, O Lord our God, when we lie down and when we arise, we will speak of Thy statutes. We rejoice in the words of Thy Torah and in Thy commandments for ever and ever, for they are our life and the length of our days and on them will we meditate day and night. Let not Thy love depart from us for all eternity. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who loves His people Israel.
